description: Checks that a monthly contract wage is at least the regional minimum wage for the employer's region on the contract start date.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 arts.90(2), 91; Decree 293/2025/NĐ-CP art.3 (the version’s rules.minimum_wage.by_region). An entity without a recorded region is checked against Region IV, the lowest floor; part-time, probation (at least 85% of the job wage, art.26) and intern terms are outside the monthly check. An incumbent hired by 31 December 2025 whose worksite moved to a lower region keeps the prior region’s Decree 74/2024 minimum (Decree 293/2025 art.5(5); contract-term facts prior_floor_region, prior_floor_reclassified).

description: Checks that the month's planned overtime, including the entry being saved, does not exceed 40 hours.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(b): overtime may not exceed 40 hours a month. Counted from the roster entries' planned overtime intervals in the month, each interval once; the engine recognises no other overtime.

description: Checks that actual overtime on a roster day does not exceed 50% of the day's normal hours, or the 12-hour daily ceiling under a weekly-hours arrangement.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(a): overtime at most 50% of the normal hours of a day; under a weekly regime normal plus overtime hours at most 12 a day.

description: Checks that a property-damage deduction does not exceed 30% of the latest payslip's net wage.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.102(3): the monthly deduction may not exceed 30% of the monthly wage actually paid after compulsory social insurance, health insurance, unemployment insurance and personal income tax.

description: Checks that the year's planned overtime does not exceed 200 hours, or 300 hours where the employer is approved for the extended cap.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(b): at most 200 hours a year; art.107(3): 300 hours in the sectors and cases listed, after notifying the provincial labour authority (art.107(4); Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP arts.61–62). Counted from the roster entries' planned overtime intervals in the calendar year, each interval once. Work on a public holiday or rest day counts only where it is entered as planned overtime; the engine recognises no other overtime.

description: Requires the sealed employer profile covering the contract start date to record a minimum-wage region.

references.title: Decree 293/2025/NĐ-CP arts.3–4: the minimum wage is the region of the employer’s place of operation.

description: Checks an hourly or daily contract rate against the regional hourly minimum, converting a daily rate over the normal hours and days.
condition:
const rate = get(ctx.entry, 'terms.rate', null);
return rate !== null && ['HOURLY', 'DAILY'].includes(rate.unit);

references.title: Decree 293/2025/NĐ-CP art.3, art.4(2)–(3): an hourly wage is at least the regional hourly minimum. A daily wage converted to an hour (over the normal hours of the day) or to a month (over the normal working days of the month) may not fall below the hourly or monthly minimum.

description: Checks that a probation wage is at least 85% of the wage the job pays at the end of probation.
validate:
const job = get(ctx.entry, 'employee_extension_data.probation_job_wage_vnd', null);
return ctx.entry.terms.rate.amount >= ctx.lookup.share * job;

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14

description: Checks the probation length against the statutory maximum for the job class.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.25: at most 180 days for an enterprise manager, 60 for a college-level job, 30 for an intermediate or technical job, 6 working days for any other.

description: Checks a roster day with actual work: a pregnant employee has no night work or overtime (no consent exception); one raising a child under 12 months needs the day’s consent for each.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.137(1)(a): no night work, overtime or long business trips from the seventh month of pregnancy (sixth in remote areas), with no consent exception; art.137(1)(b): while raising a child under 12 months, night work and overtime need the employee's day-specific consent. Read on employee_contract.children (expected_on three months ahead, born_on) and the roster day's consent object.

description: Checks the daily and weekly hours, overtime and night work of an employee under 18 against the limits for their age and job.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.146(1)(b): a worker from 15 to under 18 works at most 8 hours a day and 40 a week, overtime and night work only in the jobs the Minister lists (term fact minor_listed_job).

description: Checks the weekly rest or, where the employer averages rest monthly, the minimum rest days in the roster month.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.111(1): at least 24 consecutive hours of rest each week; where the cycle does not allow it, at least four days a month on average (entity fact rest_averaged_monthly).

description: Checks that normal hours actually worked on a roster day stay within the contract day or the 10-hour weekly-arrangement ceiling.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.105(1)–(2): normal working hours at most 8 a day and 48 a week; under a weekly arrangement at most 10 a day (term fact normal_hours_arrangement).

description: Checks that normal hours actually worked across the seven-day window stay within 48 hours.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.105(1)–(2): at most 48 normal hours a week.

description: Checks that planned overtime on a roster day is at most 50% of the contract's normal day and that normal plus overtime stays within 12 hours.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.107(2)(b): overtime at most 50% of the normal hours of a day; under a weekly arrangement normal plus overtime at most 12 a day.

description: Checks that a shift worker has at least 12 hours between the end of the previous shift and the start of the next.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.110: a shift worker rests at least 12 hours before moving to another shift.

description: Checks that a roster day with planned overtime is allowed for the employee's age and listed-job status.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.146: under 15 at most 4 hours a day and 20 a week, no overtime or night work; from 15 to under 18 at most 8 a day and 40 a week, overtime and night work only in the jobs the Minister lists (term fact minor_listed_job); night is 22:00–06:00 (art.106).

description: Checks planned overtime: a pregnant employee has none (no consent exception); one raising a child under 12 months needs the day’s overtime consent.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.137(1): no overtime from the seventh month of pregnancy (estimated delivery within three months on employee_contract.children), with no consent exception; while raising a child under 12 months, overtime needs the day's consent.

description: Checks that work by a child under 13 is limited to approved arts, physical-training or sports work.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.145(3): the employer may not recruit or use a person under 13, except in arts, physical training or sports work that does not harm the child, with the provincial labour authority’s consent (term fact child_arts_sports_approved).

description: Checks that an exit leave encashment reviews the wage of the month before the exit month and records that month’s daily wage.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.113(3): an employee who leaves or loses the job without having taken, or without having taken all, annual leave is paid the wages for the untaken days.
Decree 145/2020/ND-CP art.67(3): the wage basis for the untaken days is the contractual wage of the month immediately preceding the month of termination or job loss.

description: Checks that an exiting employee's annual-leave service review covers the exit year and any combining agreement for that employment.
condition: return get(ctx.entry, 'final_pay_due_on', null) !== null && get(ctx.entry, 'effective_range.to', null) !== null;

references.title: Decree 145/2020/ND-CP arts.65-66: periods counted as work and the months of annual-leave service.
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.113(3)-(4): untaken days are paid on leaving; leave may be combined for at most three years by agreement.

description: Requires a residency status and validates the contract's work classification and work-authorisation category against the jurisdiction lists.
Checks the bounds on structured employee inputs such as normal hours and normal days.
Checks that the signed contract period is a real fixed term within the 36-month maximum.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14, article20: actual definite or indefinite agreement; maximum fixed term36months.
ILO-hosted English text of Labour Code45/2019/QH14, article20

description: Requires an employer profile with a first-employment date to record the date operations started.
Requires an annual-leave combining agreement to name its employment and carry a reference.
Checks that an annual-leave combining agreement has a valid effective interval that starts on or after the case opens.
Requires evidence for an annual-leave combining agreement.
validate: return get(ctx.entry, 'evidence_file', null) !== null;

description: Checks that an annual-leave combining agreement lasts no more than three years.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.113(4): annual leave may be taken in several parts or combined for at most three years by agreement.

description: Supplies the roster warning thresholds (daily, weekly, monthly and rest-day limits) used by the roster board; it validates nothing itself.
validate: return true;
